task.description: Validate TEST-DESIGNER output for ISS-203. Hard gate - TEST-RUNNER cannot start until PASS.
acceptance_criteria: All 5 ISS-203 test cases have runnable integration tests
Tests fail clearly if BPM_TEST_DB_URL absent

result.summary: All 5 hard gate checks pass. TC-ISS-203-01 through TC-ISS-203-05 are present and runnable. No error.SkipZigTest on any MUST test. BPM_TEST_DB_URL absence returns error.BpmTestDbUrlMissing (not a skip). No mocks, stubs, or in-memory fakes detected. Per-test fixture isolation achieved via unique definition names and runtime-generated instance UUIDs. One MINOR gap noted in TC-203-03: the test verifies the negative invariant (trigger key does not carry the 'engine:' prefix) rather than a positive byte-exact match for a caller-supplied client key, because inst_store.create() does not accept an explicit idempotency_key parameter in the current API — this is a design-level limitation and does not block PASS.

issues.description: Client key passthrough is verified via negative assertion only (trigger key does not start with 'engine:') rather than a positive byte-exact match. inst_store.create() does not expose an idempotency_key parameter, so the full K-4 acceptance criterion cannot be exercised at the integration test layer without an API change. The existing test still confirms the correct isolation boundary (engine keys never appear on trigger events).
